subject: Re: Tiering parity request — OrbitTech migration
messages:
From: Ari Gold <ari@orbittech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orbittech.com; Kelly Park <kelly.park@orbittech.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Tiering parity request — OrbitTech migration

Marcus,

We're evaluating a move off our current provider and wanted to get a clearer read on whether Redwood can meet our commercial and feature parity needs. High level:
- Current vendor: EdgeWorks (enterprise bundle, committed 2yr)
- Usage: ~1.2B tokens/month (mixed inference/embedding); spike traffic M-F 9-18 PT
- Must-haves: private VPC option, SOC2 evidence, predictable dedicated throughput
- Current economics: effectively paying $0.0025 / token after discounts and reserved capacity; onboarding credit applied upfront

Can Redwood match on pricing and feature parity at the same scale? Attached is a short RFP summary and our current term sheet for reference.

We're targeting a decision in the next 3 weeks; if you have a template for a parity offer or migration assist (credits, pilot terms), please share.

Thanks,

Ari Gold
Head of Cloud Ops
OrbitTech
Attachment: OrbitTech_RFP_Summary.pdf (PDF)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ari Gold <ari@orbittech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tiering parity request — OrbitTech migration

Hi Ari — appreciate the level of detail, this is helpful.

Quick answers up front:
- We can support private VPC + SOC2-compliant evidence (SOC2 report shared via secure link) and have Dedicated pools sized for predictable throughput.
- Pricing: we'll need to run a short profile of your token mix and peak concurrency to finalize a match, but below is an initial commercial play we can put on the table for an exploratory offer:
  * 15% list discount for a 12-month committed baseline equal to your current tokens
  * $50,000 onboarding credit for migration/runbook work
  * 3-month pilot at scaled capacity with guaranteed rollback plan

I'm attaching a simple side-by-side that maps core features and the initial price anchor.

Would it be possible to get a 30–45 minute call tomorrow to walk through peak shapes and any custom SLAs you need? If you prefer, we can also do a brief pilot statement of work (SOW) and draft term sheet first.

Best,

Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_pricing_comparison.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Tiering parity request — internal: quick ask

Forwarding OrbitTech's note. They are an obvious high-value account if we can land predictable volume. Quick internal assessment and asks:

Key pieces from external:
- ~1.2B tokens/month; mixed generation + embeddings
- Needs private VPC, SOC2 evidence, and dedicated throughput guarantees

Proposed external-facing play (we pitched 15% + $50k onboarding credit). Need internal alignment on the following before I commit:
- Marissa: run a sensitivity on effective per-token price after committing 12 months at that volume. Show scenario with 15% and then 20% (loss leader) for first 6 months. Include estimate of infra cost + expected gross margin.
- Irene: confirm we can deliver SOC2 report and any redlines to standard Dedicated contract (data residency/retention clauses). Also check whether onboarding credit requires a services SOW.
- Connor: evaluate runtime compatibility and any risks for their peak concurrency (they said spikes 9-18 PT). Do we need burst pools or an initial dedicated headroom? Estimate ops effort (hours) for migration.

Also think about a fallback commercial: 12-mo commit at 10% + 6-month usage-based true-up clause if they exceed baseline >120%.

I'll take the call later today at 4pm PT if that works; plan to propose pilot SOW + draft term sheet.

Marcus

Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tiering parity request — OrbitTech migration

Ari — thanks for the call earlier. Per our discussion, here's a concise parity+migration offer for OrbitTech to review:

Offer highlights (conditional on a 12-month committed baseline equal to current tokens):
- Commercial: 15% off list pricing for the 12-month committed baseline; effective starting rate ~ $0.002125 / token.
- Onboarding: $50,000 one-time onboarding credit applied to services SOW (migration playbooks, runbook validation, smoke tests).
- Pilot: 3-month pilot at proposed baseline with option to scale; during pilot we guarantee dedicated headroom matching their stated peak concurrency with defined rollback plan.
- SLA: Standard Dedicated SLA included; we can discuss a 99.9% uptime uplift as an add-on (we'll provide cost after Marissa's infra sensitivity).
- Compliance: We will provide SOC2 Type II report via secure link; Irene will follow up with any contract redline guidance.
- True-up: If monthly usage exceeds 120% of baseline for 2 consecutive months, we'll trigger a scaling review and offer a mutual true-up clause (details in term sheet).

Attachments: redwood_pricing_comparison.xlsx — maps features to EdgeWorks and shows the anchor math.

Next steps:
1) If this looks directionally acceptable, we can send a short pilot SOW + draft term sheet by EOD tomorrow.
2) Schedule a 45-minute kickoff (technical deep dive + legal/commercial) — pick a time here: https://cal.redwood.com/marcus/45

We want to make migration as frictionless as possible; the onboarding credit is intended to cover the majority of migration engineering effort. If you'd rather, we can push a deeper discount in exchange for a longer commit (18–24 months).

Best,

Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_pricing_comparison.xlsx (xlsx)
